title: Enforce versioned routing + client telemetry to accelerate removal of old completions endpoints
creator: Asha Patel
description: PRD to implement versioned routing and server-side telemetry so we can safely accelerate removal of the legacy /v0/completions and chat-v1 endpoints. The goal is to (1) return clear deprecation metadata to callers, (2) route traffic by explicit client version when configured, and (3) collect deterministic telemetry to identify remaining high-usage customers for targeted outreach and migration assistance. This ticket scopes the product requirements, rollout plan, acceptance criteria, and monitoring runbook for the feature set.
acceptance_criteria: API exposes an HTTP response header 'X-Redwood-Deprecation' with structured values: target_endpoint, removal_date, migration_doc_url for all requests to legacy endpoints

Routing layer supports 'client-version' header and query param to opt into versioned routing; when present it pins requests to matching model variants or returns a 409 with migration guidance if incompatible

Telemetry pipeline emits per-tenant counts of legacy-endpoint requests, model variant, SDK language, and 'client-version' where available; data is available in the console and a BigQuery table within 2 hours
Rollout feature flag exists to enable server-side deprecation headers and routing in stages (internal-only -> beta customers -> public) without client code changes
Dashboard tile in Console (Release: api-2026.04) shows top 50 tenants by daily legacy-endpoint traffic and trends; alert triggers when a tenant accounts for >5% of cluster legacy token volume
Migration guide published and linked in headers: doc contains client-side code snippets for JS, Python, and Go showing how to move to the named stable endpoints and pin models
E2E and integration tests in repo GH-9876 validate header presence, routing behavior, and telemetry emission; failing tests block rollout
Security review completed and flagged as not introducing new data exposure (security_review_required = false)
discussion: 2026-02-20 - Asha: Created PRD after data review; legacy endpoints still represent ~28% of completions tokens. Proposed approach: non-breaking headers + versioned routing to give visibility before hard cut.
2026-02-25 - Diego: Engineering will reuse the existing API gateway plugin for header injection and add a lightweight version router. Estimate 5 points across infra + runtime teams.

2026-03-01 - PM/Design review: UX team requests a one-click migration widget in Console to generate client upgrade snippets for top customer languages. Added to scope as low-effort follow-up if telemetry shows concentrated usage.
2026-03-04 - SRE: We need rate-limiting fallbacks for clients that respond to 409s by retrying; will implement exponential backoff guidance in migration docs.
2026-03-08 - Legal & Compliance: Confirmed header content OK, no PII. KMS/HSM unchanged. Security review flagged as not required for this change.

2026-03-10 - Diego: Integration PR GH-9876 opened. Initial tests show telemetry arrives but sample rate is too low for small tenants; increased sampling to 100% for legacy endpoints during beta window.
2026-03-12 - Asha: Updated acceptance criteria to require dashboard alerting and a migration guide link in header. Preparing stakeholder announcement draft for 2026-03-20.

Planned next steps: run internal-only rollouts, monitor telemetry for 2 weeks, invite top 25 tenants to beta migration, then enable public deprecation headers and soft 409 enforcement before a hard removal date is announced.
notes: Trade-offs: adding headers is non-breaking and low risk, but relying on client-version header will be incomplete — we will backfill with SDK fingerprinting heuristics in ENG-20412. If telemetry shows a long tail of small tenants, we'll offer automated migration support via Solutions Engineering. Rollout must coordinate with Dedicated and Private to ensure header behavior is consistent across modes.
